items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Yeah, the original Tuxedo. Yeah. Me Pazzo and Maurice Duran. I was leading that band.

ctx.x: I've had a couple of books of John Robichaud's too with his name stamped on that I got from Maurice Durand or something like that.
That's right. Well, she gave, in other words she gave me half of a gift for Maurice because that was his supplement.
He still has some of them, but I'm in California.

items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: INTERVIEWER: I've had a couple of books of John Robichaud's too with his name stamped on that I got from Maurice Durand or something like that. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. Well, she gave, in other words she gave me half of a gift for Maurice because that was his supplement.

ctx.x: I have up in the front there, a whole lot of music when I had the big band. Willie Pajor and Bill Matthews, the way, with me and the big band. And I have a lot of music. A lot of music. And when Professor John Robichaud died, his wife was Anna, she gave me quite a bit of music. You know what I mean? At that time.
I've had a couple of books of John Robichaud's too with his name stamped on that I got from Maurice Durand or something like that.
That's right. Well, she gave, in other words she gave me half of a gift for Maurice because that was his supplement.
